_purpose: Test investigation archetype (Investigation 6, Awareness 5, Systems 4), murder mystery structure, witness NPC interviews, forensic evidence gathering, time-pressure tribunal deadline, red herrings and misdirection
_comment_tactical: === TACTICAL MODULE - DISABLED (Investigation Focus, Combat Only if Confronting Killer) ===
_scenario_hint: Sovereign Nexus Gestation Facility (void_level 1, high security), Gestator Lyss Veln found dead in pod chamber with void contamination marks. Evidence suggests: Bond corruption ritual gone wrong, sabotage by anti-Nexus agent, or accidental void exposure during unauthorized experiment. 6 NPC witnesses with conflicting testimonies, partial security logs, ritual residue. Time pressure: Nexus tribunal convenes in 10 rounds - must present case with evidence. Red herrings: jealous co-worker, corporate espionage, secret Bond affair.

_design_notes.ml_training_value: First investigation-led config, tests Investigation/Awareness/Systems/Insight for detective work, NPC witness interview depth, evidence collection mechanics, time-pressure clock (tribunal deadline), red herring misdirection, forensic analysis, moral choice (truth vs. political pressure)
_design_notes.character_innovation: Investigation 6 detective, Systems 4 forensics specialist, Charm 5 witness interviewer, recording drones, data recorders, forensic scanners, void detectors

starting_clocks.name: Tribunal Deadline
starting_clocks.description: Time until Nexus tribunal convenes. At 0 ticks: must present case or investigation deemed failure, political scapegoat chosen.
starting_clocks.advance_meaning: tribunal deadline worsens or time runs out

starting_clocks.name: Evidence Collection
starting_clocks.description: Critical evidence gathered. At 8 ticks: enough evidence for solid case (if correct suspect identified).

starting_clocks.name: Witness Cooperation
starting_clocks.description: NPC willingness to testify. At 0 ticks: witnesses clam up, refuse cooperation. At 6 ticks: witnesses fully cooperate, reveal secrets.

players.name: Inspector Veyra Kross
goals: Find truth regardless of political pressure

players.name: Forensic Analyst Kael Ren
goals: Analyze ritual residue and void contamination patterns
Determine cause of death (ritual vs. physical)

players.name: Witness Liaison Mira Thane
goals: Interview witnesses and extract truthful testimony
Detect lies and uncover hidden motives

notes: ML Training Focus: Investigation archetype (Investigation 6, Awareness 6, Insight 6, Systems 6), murder mystery structure with 6+ NPC witnesses, forensic evidence analysis, time-pressure tribunal clock, lie detection (Insight), witness interview techniques (Charm), scientific analysis (Systems/Science). Tests underrepresented investigation gameplay, NPC interaction depth, evidence-based reasoning, red herring navigation. Long campaign (14 turns) allows thorough investigation, witness relationship building, evidence synthesis, dramatic reveal.
